reuse.why: Extends the existing applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend helpers that every schedule path already calls, so holidays flow through them without new call-site logic.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test is factored into one isNonWorkingDay predicate used by both the daily skip and the shift; the padding bound is one exported function.

placement.why: Date-rule logic stays in shared/schedules.ts, the field is added to RecurConfig and carried by parseRecurDate where the other weekend fields are carried.

scope.why: Only the type, the recur-date parser, the shared weekend helpers, the range padding and tests change.

maintainability.why: A single predicate and a documented padding bound make the rule easy to own; the optional parameter defaults keep old callers unchanged.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All sites (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) go through applyWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the previous isWeekend checks are replaced by the shared predicate.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts isNonWorkingDay used by applyWeekendRule and getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which all schedule date paths call.
